summary: Rapid7 Exposure Command Essentials: it finds and helps fix vulnerabilities across the infrastructure, together with an asset inventory and external attack surface.
value: Vulnerabilities in the network and on computers are found and ranked by real risk.
It shows every asset and which are exposed to the internet.
simple: Finds vulnerabilities across the whole infrastructure and helps close them. Scans the network and computers with agents, checks configurations against policies, sets priorities based on real-world threats and asset importance, and manages remediation with deadlines and reports. Also shows the whole attack surface — a single list of assets, resources visible from the internet, and the connections between them — and includes automation (SOAR).
notIncluded: Cloud protection (CNAPP) and dynamic application testing (DAST) are in Ultimate.
classification: The classes are Surface Command plus vulnerability management.
